en.title: Quality Control in Food and Beverage Manufacturing
en.description: How quality control works in a food factory: incoming checks, in-process checks, testing and traceability.

sections.heading: Quality is built in, not inspected in
paragraphs: Checking only the finished product finds problems too late. Good plants control quality at three points: incoming ingredients, during production and finished goods.

sections.heading: Common checks
paragraphs: Moisture content, net weight, seal integrity, appearance, taste and aroma, and metal detection. Microbiological tests are usually done by an accredited laboratory according to regulation.

sections.heading: Reference samples
paragraphs: The sample you approved becomes the standard. Each batch is compared with it, which is how taste stays the same from batch to batch.

sections.heading: Traceability
paragraphs: Every batch has a lot code linked to ingredient lots and production records. If a problem is found later, it can be traced and contained quickly.

id.title: Kontrol Mutu dalam Manufaktur Makanan dan Minuman
id.description: Cara kerja kontrol mutu di pabrik makanan: pemeriksaan bahan masuk, selama proses, pengujian, dan ketertelusuran.

sections.heading: Mutu dibangun, bukan hanya diperiksa
paragraphs: Memeriksa produk jadi saja menemukan masalah terlalu terlambat. Pabrik yang baik mengendalikan mutu di tiga titik: bahan baku masuk, selama produksi, dan barang jadi.

sections.heading: Pemeriksaan yang umum
paragraphs: Kadar air, berat neto, keutuhan segel, tampilan, rasa dan aroma, serta deteksi logam. Uji mikrobiologi biasanya dilakukan laboratorium terakreditasi sesuai peraturan.

sections.heading: Sampel acuan
paragraphs: Sampel yang Anda setujui menjadi standar. Setiap batch dibandingkan dengannya, dan itulah cara rasa tetap sama dari batch ke batch.

sections.heading: Ketertelusuran
paragraphs: Setiap batch memiliki kode lot yang terhubung dengan lot bahan baku dan catatan produksi. Jika ada masalah belakangan, penyebabnya bisa dilacak dan ditangani dengan cepat.
